passages.context: In his collection's introduction to the Canons of Laodicea, Joannou treats the material as local Phrygian canonical tradition, a summary, and possibly the product of two codification stages. This controls Joannou's edition-local historical framing, not universal reception or a complete manuscript-history claim.
